ios.desc:
MedNotes App: The Ultimate Resource for Medical Students

The MedNotes app is your all-in-one solution for comprehensive medical learning. Designed for MBBS, NEET PG, and USMLE aspirants, it offers over 2,500 detailed medical notes across a wide range of subjects. With more than 10 million users—including medical students and professionals—MedNotes is the trusted resource for daily learning.

Why MedNotes?
> Comprehensive Coverage: Over 2,500 medical notes spanning essential topics like Anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, and more.
> Rich Visuals: Access 50,000+ images, charts, diagrams, and tables to enhance your learning.
> Concise and Structured: Notes are point-wise, to the point, and tailored for quick understanding.
> Clinical Focus: Includes clinical notes, diagrams, and practicals for a hands-on approach to learning.

What’s Included?
> 2500+ MedNotes
> 50+ Disorders
> 100+ Question Papers
> 150+ Histology Slides
> 350+ Cadaveric Images
> Practical Resources
...and much more.

Subjects Covered:
(Free Notes from our paid Ebooks)
> Anatomy
> Physiology
> Biochemistry
> Neuroanatomy
> Embryology
> Pharmacology
> Pathology
> Microbiology
> ENT
> FMT
> PSM
> Medicine
> Radiology
> Disease Section

Ongoing Updates --
We’re committed to providing you with continuous updates. With your one-time purchase, you will receive access to all future updates—including new notes and materials as they are added to the app.

Why Choose MedNotes?
> The only app you need for all your medical learning materials.
> An expansive library designed for students preparing for MBBS, NEET PG, and USMLE exams.
> No subscriptions—enjoy lifetime access with a single purchase.

For any questions or support, please reach out to us at: mednotes.in@gmail.com

Made with Love,
The MedNotes Team

android.desc: MedNotes app is for all First & Second Year Medical Students out there. We have included : 1) MedNotes [ 1500+ ] 2) Disorders [ 50+ ] 3) MedBooks [ 500+ ] 4) Question papers [ 100+ ] 5) Histology Slide [ 150+ ] 6) Cadaveric Images [ 350+ ] 7) Practicals and much more. Our website (mednotes.in) & App both have been created for and by Medical Students. The contents and notes in this app are standard in terms of quality and time. We are adding and updating contents every day on the website. We will update the contents of the app once per month. Right now, we have Anatomy, Physiology, Pharmacology, Pathology, Biochemistry, Neuroanatomy, and Embryology Notes available on the app. We have also included a Disease Section. The best part is everything here, is absolutely free! All the notes, practicals, diagrams, books, histology slides etc, all are free and are available for download, anywhere and will remain like this forever. For any queries or issues, mail us : mednotes.in@gmail.com Made with Love MedNotes
